thread:
mika: quick check — spotted a base64 blob in staging logs from router-worker on startup. looks like an API token or wrapped ciphertext, unsure which. do we treat this as an immediate rotate?

sam: can you paste the exact line (redact full secret) and the grep you used?

mika: redacted line: `Received token: ********c2VjcmV0YmFzZTY0...==`
command: `kubectl logs -n staging deploy/router-worker | grep 'Received token' -n`

jordan: treat as secret exposure until proven otherwise. first: assume compromise, rotate secrets that could be derived. second: determine if it's raw token vs KMS-encrypted blob. if KMS ciphertext, need to re-encrypt after rotating plaintext.

eva: tagging @security-bot for an audit log and to pull matching Vault/secret-manager entries. also add `--since` to log grep so we limit range.

security-bot: investigation ticket created: https://internal.tickets/INV-2315 (automated). please attach redacted log snippet and service manifest.

ops: quick runbook (staging):
1) locate secret name in env / configmap / vault
2) rotate secret in Vault / SecretManager
3) update k8s secret: `kubectl -n staging delete secret router-creds && kubectl -n staging create secret generic router-creds --from-literal=API_KEY=<new>` or use existing pipeline
4) restart deployment: `kubectl -n staging rollout restart deploy/router-worker`
5) revoke any sessions/tokens tied to old secret
6) add log redaction rule (see below)

jordan: commands to check KMS usage / decryptors: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/my-app-staging-key` and `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-01`

sam: suggested log-redaction regex to add to logging pipeline: `(?i)received token:\s*[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{12,}` — apply at ingestion and to historical slices as a precaution. also run `rg` over recent logs to find other occurrences.

mika: on approval — i'll rotate the Vault secret and push redeploy for staging. who signs off for rotating KMS keys if needed? staging only but want to follow process.

jordan: KMS key rotation/deletion has stricter approval (key-owners + sec lead). For staging you can rotate secrets at the Vault level without touching the CMK; only escalate KMS rotation if we find Decrypt events to unknown principals.

eva: i'll review access grants and list principals with decrypt permissions, then share findings. if anything suspicious, we escalate.

ops: also: scrub logs from S3/ELK that contain the blob (run redact script) and add a short-term retention/lock while we review.

mika: ack — i'll attach the PR with the rotated secret and a short incident note. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sam: nice catch, thanks for flagging.

jordan: quick follow-up — add a unit test / linter rule to detect accidental prints of env vars in startup code path. smaller wins avoid repeated incidents.

mika: will open a dev ticket for linter rule.

security-bot: audit summary will be posted to INV-2315 once scans complete.
